hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that bypasses Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity by routing swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote from a custom curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens — fully handling swap execution via BeforeSwapDelta. Standard liquidity provision and donations are blocked by reverting hooks.
